words: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
rows.speaker: ابن عمر
rows.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports that the Prophet, mounting for travel, said takbīr three times, recited the verse, prayed for piety, accepted deeds, an easy journey and protection for his family, and on return praised God as a repentant traveler.
rows.anchor: عن ابن عمر، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم كان إذا سافر فركب راحلته كبر ثلاثا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Ḥibbān presents this transmission as evidence against the claim that Ḥammād b. Salama alone transmitted Abu al-Zubayr's report.
rows.anchor: حدثنا ابن وهب، عن ابن جريج، أن أبا الزبير أخبره

words: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
rows.speaker: عبد الله بن عمر
rows.claim: Ibn ʿUmar reports that the Prophet mounted for travel, said takbīr three times and recited the verse; he prayed for piety, ease, protection from hardship and a safe return, then repeated the prayer on return with added praise.
rows.anchor: أن أبا الزبير أخبره، أن عليا الأسدي أخبره، أن عبد الله بن عمر علمه، أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم

words: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
rows.speaker: علي بن ربيعة الأسدي
rows.claim: ʿAlī b. Rabīʿa recounts that ʿAlī invoked God while mounting, praised His provision and subjection of transport, recited 43:13–14, said takbīr three times and sought forgiveness; he adds that the Prophet did likewise while he rode behind him.
rows.anchor: عن علي بن ربيعة الأسدي، قال: ركب علي دابة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Ḥibbān frames ʿAlī's expanded riding invocation as showing that a person may add other phrases to this supplication.
rows.anchor: الحمد لله الذي أكرمنا، وحملنا في البر والبحر، ورزقنا من الطيبات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ibn Ḥibbān frames the passage as God's reproach of those who opposed the Messenger regarding affirmation of divine decree.
rows.anchor: كان مشركو قريش عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يخالفونه

rows.speaker: أبو هريرة
rows.claim: Abū Hurayra reports that Quraysh's polytheists disputed predestination with the Prophet, and this revelation comprised 54:47–49, including the declaration that all things are created by decree.
rows.anchor: عن أبي هريرة قال كان مشركو قريش عند رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم يخالفونه
